headers.comment: Tokens live in localStorage, so XSS is the threat that matters. Monaco needs worker-src blob:; 'unsafe-inline' on styles is required by Next's inlined critical CSS.
headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; worker-src 'self' blob:; connect-src 'self' https://api.codelock.app http://localhost:4000; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'
